Coupled Technique(s).cell: Agilent 7700x Q-ICP-MS (used for Pb isotope comparison; stated section 2.4)
Coupled Technique(s).value: Agilent 7700x Q-ICP-MS (used for Pb isotope comparison; stated section 2.4)

Coupling Description.cell: Q-ICP-MS Pb isotope ratios compared with SF-ICP-MS values for validation; Q-ICP-MS showed higher uncertainties (stated section 2.4)
Coupling Description.value: Q-ICP-MS Pb isotope ratios compared with SF-ICP-MS values for validation; Q-ICP-MS showed higher uncertainties (stated section 2.4)

Target Material.cell: Soil samples (sequential acid leach fractions; stated abstract)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Weighed split of a digest or leachate -- rock chips 0.05-0.24 g, soils 1-2.3 g; "weighed splits taken for trace element and high-precision Pb isotope analysis by MC-ICPMS. At least 50% of each solution was retained for Pb isotope analysis by SC-SF-ICP-MS and Q-ICP-MS"; "Small splits of the soil samples (TD, AR) were used for Pb isotope analysis on a Nu Instruments Attom"
Sampling Unit Type.value: Weighed split of a digest or leachate -- rock chips 0.05-0.24 g, soils 1-2.3 g; "weighed splits taken for trace element and high-precision Pb isotope analysis by MC-ICPMS. At least 50% of each solution was retained for Pb isotope analysis by SC-SF-ICP-MS and Q-ICP-MS"; "Small splits of the soil samples (TD, AR) were used for Pb isotope analysis on a Nu Instruments Attom"

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Sequential acid leaching of bulk soil (TD and AR fractions; stated section 2.2)
Sample Preparation Method.value: Sequential acid leaching of bulk soil (TD and AR fractions; stated section 2.2)

Digestion Acid(s).cell: Rock chips: concentrated HF, then concentrated HNO3, then 5 M HNO3. Soil total dissolution: concentrated HNO3 organic-destruction leach (discarded), then concentrated HF, then concentrated HNO3, then 6 M HCl. Soil aqua-regia fraction: 3 ml aqua regia (3:1 HCl:HNO3).

value.value: concentrated HF, then concentrated HNO3, then 5 M HNO3. Soil total dissolution: concentrated HNO3 organic-destruction leach (discarded), then concentrated HF, then concentrated HNO3, then 6 M HCl. Soil aqua-regia fraction: 3 ml aqua regia (3:1 HCl:HNO3).

Digestion Step.cell: Rock chips, 1: concentrated HF (3 ml, 100 deg C, 48 h, then evaporation) | 2: concentrated HNO3 (2 x 1 ml, 100 deg C, 12 h) | 3: 5 M HNO3 (5 ml, 100 deg C, 15 h). Soil total-dissolution fraction, 1: concentrated HNO3 (3 ml, 80 deg C, 48 h) to destroy organics, this leachate discarded | 2: concentrated HF (4 ml, 100 deg C, 48 h, then evaporation) | 3: concentrated HNO3 (2 x 1 ml, 100 deg C) | 4: 6 M HCl (5 ml, 80 deg C, 15 h). Soil aqua-regia fraction, 1: 3 ml aqua regia (3:1 HCl:HNO3), shaken.

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: None (Pb separation performed for MC-ICP-MS only; SF-ICP-MS uses unseparated leachate with Tl addition; stated section 2.3)
Chromatographic Separation Applied.value: None (Pb separation performed for MC-ICP-MS only; SF-ICP-MS uses unseparated leachate with Tl addition; stated section 2.3)

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: None (Tl added for mass fractionation correction only, not ID)
Isotope Dilution Spike.value: None (Tl added for mass fractionation correction only, not ID)

Instrument Manufacturer.cell: Nu Instruments -- "a Nu Instruments Attom SC-SF-ICP-MS"
Instrument Manufacturer.value: Nu Instruments -- "a Nu Instruments Attom SC-SF-ICP-MS"

Mass Resolution Setting.cell: N (Nu Attom uses deflector peak jump; no LR/MR/HR designation stated; stated section 2.3)

Detector Configuration.cell: Single SEM; deflector peak jump mode for Pb isotopes (stated section 2.3)
Detector Configuration.value: Single SEM; deflector peak jump mode for Pb isotopes (stated section 2.3)

Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.cell: Glass Expansion cyclonic spray chamber (stated section 2.3)
Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.value: Glass Expansion cyclonic spray chamber (stated section 2.3)

Analytical Mode.cell: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- "The Attom was operated with a Glass Expansion cyclonic spray chamber and glass nebulizer (uptake rate 0.33 ml/min)"; "both operated in wet plasma mode"; ESI SC-2 DX autosampler
Analytical Mode.value: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- "The Attom was operated with a Glass Expansion cyclonic spray chamber and glass nebulizer (uptake rate 0.33 ml/min)"; "both operated in wet plasma mode"; ESI SC-2 DX autosampler

ICP Tuning.cell: "The instrument was tuned to provide ~1000 kcps/ppb Pbtotal while maintaining flat-topped peaks"
ICP Tuning.value: "The instrument was tuned to provide ~1000 kcps/ppb Pbtotal while maintaining flat-topped peaks"

Target Species.cell: Pb isotopes (204Pb, 206Pb, 207Pb, 208Pb) with mass fractionation monitors 202Hg, 203Tl, 205Tl (stated section 2.3)

value.member: Pb isotopes (204Pb, 206Pb, 207Pb, 208Pb) with mass fractionation monitors 202Hg

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species

Mass Resolution Assignment.cell: N (Nu Attom uses deflector peak jump; resolution mode not stated in LR/MR/HR terms)

E-scan Range.cell: N/A (Nu Attom uses deflector peak jump, not E-scan)

Number of Scans per Replicate.cell: 2000 sweeps per set x 30 sets (stated section 2.3)

Number of Replicates.cell: 1 (30 sets of 2000 sweeps = single 4.5 min continuous analysis; stated section 2.3)
Number of Replicates.value: 1 (30 sets of 2000 sweeps = single 4.5 min continuous analysis; stated section 2.3)

Wash Time Between Samples.cell: 10 s in two 2% HNO3 reservoirs (stated section 2.3)
Wash Time Between Samples.value: 10 s in two 2% HNO3 reservoirs (stated section 2.3)

Internal Standard Element.cell: Tl (203Tl and 205Tl for mass fractionation correction; stated section 2.3)

Internal Standard Concentration.cell: 1 ppb Tl in sample matrix (stated section 2.3)
Internal Standard Concentration.value: 1 ppb Tl in sample matrix (stated section 2.3)

Drift Correction Method.cell: Tl mass bias correction + master Pb-Tl correlation lines from NIST SRM981 bracketing (stated section 2.3)
Drift Correction Method.value: Tl mass bias correction + master Pb-Tl correlation lines from NIST SRM981 bracketing (stated section 2.3)

Calibration Strategy per Target Species.cell: Tl-normalized mass bias correction + NIST SRM981 master correlation lines (stated section 2.3)

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: On-peak zero (10 s wash blank before each measurement; stated section 2.3)
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: On-peak zero (10 s wash blank before each measurement; stated section 2.3)

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Y (204Hg on 204Pb corrected using 202Hg monitor; stated section 2.3)
Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.value: Y (204Hg on 204Pb corrected using 202Hg monitor; stated section 2.3)

Interference Correction Method.cell: Mass-balance correction: measured 202Hg signal used to subtract 204Hg contribution from 204Pb (stated section 2.3)

value.value: measured 202Hg signal used to subtract 204Hg contribution from 204Pb (stated section 2.3)

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: 10 s wash in two 2% HNO3 reservoirs between samples (stated section 2.3)
Memory Effect Mitigation.value: 10 s wash in two 2% HNO3 reservoirs between samples (stated section 2.3)

Uncertainty Level.cell: Both conventions stated: 2SD for external reproducibility ("(2sd, n = 22)", "%2sd", "n = 9 for JB-2 and n = 11 for JB-3, +/-2sd%") and 2SE for internal precision ("typical internal precision (2se)", "Typical within-run precision (2 standard errors)")
Uncertainty Level.value: Both conventions stated: 2SD for external reproducibility ("(2sd, n = 22)", "%2sd", "n = 9 for JB-2 and n = 11 for JB-3, +/-2sd%") and 2SE for internal precision ("typical internal precision (2se)", "Typical within-run precision (2 standard errors)")

Calibration Factor and Determination Met.cell: Instrumental mass-fractionation factor: "Raw Pb isotope ratios were corrected for instrumental mass fractionation using the measured 205Tl/203Tl and Pb mass bias factors derived from Pb vs Tl isotope mass bias plots generated from numerous analyses of SRM981"; "Pb mass bias factors were taken from master Pb-Tl mass bias correlation lines". The magnitude "ca. 0.7% per mass unit" is stated for the MC-ICP-MS, not for the SC-SF-ICP-MS

value.value: "Raw Pb isotope ratios were corrected for instrumental mass fractionation using the measured 205Tl/203Tl and Pb mass bias factors derived from Pb vs Tl isotope mass bias plots generated from numerous analyses of SRM981"

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially -- n stated per averaged result (BCR-2 n = 39, AGV-2 n = 13, BR n = 11, JB-2 n = 9, JB-3 n = 11, SRM981 n = 22 and n = 16). One documented exclusion, from the quality assessment rather than from a reported aggregate: "Results for the pure Pb standard NIST SRM981, analysed many times with the soil samples, are not included here, because it contains no matrix and may thus not a be a good indicator of data quality for the soil samples analysed here" [sec 3.1]. No acceptance or rejection rule, and no acquired-versus-included count, stated
Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.value: Partially -- n stated per averaged result (BCR-2 n = 39, AGV-2 n = 13, BR n = 11, JB-2 n = 9, JB-3 n = 11, SRM981 n = 22 and n = 16). One documented exclusion, from the quality assessment rather than from a reported aggregate: "Results for the pure Pb standard NIST SRM981, analysed many times with the soil samples, are not included here, because it contains no matrix and may thus not a be a good indicator of data quality for the soil samples analysed here" [sec 3.1]. No acceptance or rejection rule, and no acquired-versus-included count, stated

Combination Method.cell: all: average of repeat analyses of each reference material — 'Results for SRM981 analysed with the NVP samples yield average ...'; averages with '2sd' and n for BCR-2, AGV-2, BR, JB-2 and JB-3

value.value: average of repeat analyses of each reference material

Constants and Reference Values Used.cell: 205Tl/203Tl = 2.3871 (Woodhead 2002), used to correct instrumental mass fractionation by internal normalisation with the exponential law
Constants and Reference Values Used.value: 205Tl/203Tl = 2.3871 (Woodhead 2002), used to correct instrumental mass fractionation by internal normalisation with the exponential law

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: NIST SRM981 Common Lead Standard (stated section 2.3)

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: BCR-2, AGV-2, JB-2, BR, JB-3 (stated Tables 1-2)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property
Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.cell: A single analysis of 30-40 10-s integrations gives typical internal precision (2SE) of +/-0.001-0.002 for 206Pb/204Pb and +/-0.003-0.005 for 208Pb/204Pb

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: 2 sigma uncertainty of 30-set Pb isotope ratios per sample (stated section 2.3)

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: % deviation from published Pb isotope values for geological RMs (BCR-2, AGV-2, JB-2, BR, JB-3; stated section 3)

Additional Notes.cell: Nu Attom SC-SF-ICP-MS in single-collector mode; 30 sets x 2000 sweeps = 4.5 min total analysis; Tl-spiked matrix (1 ppb Tl) for mass bias correction; blank ~900 cps on 208Pb (stated section 2.3)
Additional Notes.value: Nu Attom SC-SF-ICP-MS in single-collector mode; 30 sets x 2000 sweeps = 4.5 min total analysis; Tl-spiked matrix (1 ppb Tl) for mass bias correction; blank ~900 cps on 208Pb (stated section 2.3)
